name: Audience contact
summary: A contact-details answer on the audience phone: name, email, phone and text fields, each labelled, with the right phone keyboard, autofill hint and text direction, and a respondent error for a missing or malformed entry.
highlights: Name, email, phone and free-text fields from one JSON list
Phone keyboard, autofill hint and left-to-right email and phone in a right-to-left page
Optional dial-code Select: flag and code closed, country name in the list
Translatable through `strings`, `testid` hooks, and a lock that restores the answer after an iframe remount
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-audience-contact> — for the details a participant leaves on the audience phone. Each entry of `fields` is an <aha-audience-field> (label above, in the deck ink) around an <aha-counted-input> at size large, with <aha-field-error variant="respondent"> under it, so it carries the same field look as every audience field; never a native form. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Fields
spec.value: one per `fields` entry, stacked 16px apart, each a label (16px / 24px, deck ink) over a 48px Counted input at 16px / 24px; full width, no counter

spec.label: Kinds
spec.value: name: text, autofill name, direction auto. email: email keyboard, autofill email, left to right. phone: dial pad, autofill tel (tel-national once a dial-code Select sits in front), left to right. text: plain text, direction auto

spec.label: Dial code
spec.value: with `dial-codes`, an 88px large (48px tall) Select sits before the phone field, 8px gap, and stays first in a right-to-left page; the phone value reads "<code> <number>". An entry with `country` reads flag and code closed ("🇻🇳 +84") and flag, country name and code in the open list ("🇻🇳 Vietnam (+84)"); the name is `name`, else Intl.DisplayNames in `locale`, else English

spec.label: Error
spec.value: after leaving a field: an empty required field, an email that is not one or a phone with fewer than 5 or more than 15 digits shows its message with the warning glyph 8px below in <aha-field-error variant="respondent" icon>, linked to the input through ariaDescribedByElements, and the field takes the error border; `showErrors()` shows every field's error at once

spec.label: Locked
spec.value: disabled or a locked lock-key: every field is disabled and the submitted answer is restored

spec.label: Copy
spec.value: every built-in text is a key of `contactStrings.en`, overridable through `strings`: groupLabel ("Contact details"), optionalLabel ("(optional)"), requiredMessage, emailMessage, phoneMessage, dialCodeLabel ("Country code"), nameLabel, emailLabel, phoneLabel; a dedicated attribute wins over `strings`, and a field's own `label` wins over the kind label

spec.label: Test hooks
spec.value: `testid="<prefix>"` stamps data-testid <prefix>-<id> on the field, <prefix>-<id>-input on its text box (<prefix>-<id>-number on a phone box behind a dial code), <prefix>-<id>-country on the dial code Select and <prefix>-<id>-error on the error; every field and text box also carries data-field="<id>". Parts: contact, field and its kind (field name, field phone…), phone, dial-code, input, error

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck ink (xprops.slide.textColour) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: accent
props.desc: The deck accent (presentationColorPalette[0]) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: fields
props.default: a required name and a required email
props.desc: The fields in order. `kind` is name, email, phone or text; `id` keys the value (a repeated id is skipped with a console warning); `label` is the translated visible label; only `required: true` makes a field required, and its input carries aria-required

props.name: dial-codes
props.desc: Puts a country-code Select before every phone field; the first entry is chosen until the participant picks another. `value` is what the phone value starts with (a dial code, or a country code so countries sharing +1 stay apart). With `country` (ISO 3166 alpha-2) the closed Select shows the flag and dial code and the list shows flag, country name and (dial code); `dial` is the code (else the `+…` in `label`), `name` the country name (else Intl.DisplayNames in `locale`); `label` defaults to the flag and dial code

props.name: dial-code-label
props.desc: The Select's accessible name; pass translated text (or `strings.dialCodeLabel`)

props.name: value
props.desc: The answer keyed by field id, as an attribute (JSON) or the `value` property (object); `valid` is true when every required field is filled and every email and phone is real

props.name: group-label
props.desc: The group's accessible name: pass the translated question (else aria-label, else `strings.groupLabel`)

props.name: optional-label
props.desc: Text added after the label of a field that is not required; pass translated text, or an empty value for none. Wins over `strings.optionalLabel`

props.name: required-message / email-message / phone-message
props.default: This field is required / Enter a real email address / Enter a real phone number
props.desc: The respondent errors; pass translated text. Each wins over the same key in `strings`

props.name: strings
props.desc: Overrides any built-in text, as on aha-chart: groupLabel, optionalLabel, requiredMessage, emailMessage, phoneMessage, dialCodeLabel, nameLabel, emailLabel, phoneLabel; a missing key keeps the English default

props.name: locale
props.desc: The language of the country names in the dial-code list

props.name: testid
props.desc: Prefix for data-testid hooks: <prefix>-<id> (field), -<id>-input (text box), -<id>-number (phone box behind a dial code), -<id>-country (dial code Select), -<id>-error; the text boxes sit in the field's shadow root, which Playwright's getByTestId reaches

props.name: lock-key
props.desc: The submission-lock key for this question: once a submission is locked under it, the element locks and restores the submitted answer, including after an iframe remount

props.name: showErrors()
props.desc: Shows every field's error at once, as on a submit attempt, and returns `valid`

props.name: change
props.desc: Fires on every keystroke and dial-code pick with the answer object and whether it is valid

whenToUse.when: a question that asks for name, email or phone on the audience phone: a follow-up request, a prize draw
a single labelled text, number or dropdown field
a login or sign-up form in the product

opinion.note: Replaces hand-built name, email and phone inputs, which re-open the field look, the phone keyboards, the right-to-left direction of an email or number, the validation and the submission lock. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element).

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a version-pinned CDN import and plain HTML, for a build-less slide page.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the light-deck example with no deck applied (DS defaults).
